en-US.title: TeamClaw Desktop
en-US.shortDescription: Turn OpenClaw instances into a coordinated virtual software team.
en-US.description: TeamClaw Desktop bundles a fully offline OpenClaw + TeamClaw runtime and a native desktop cockpit for running an autonomous software team. One setup wizard wires your LLM provider, then TeamClaw sweeps your GitHub repositories on its own schedule, plans and assigns work across role-based workers (PM, architect, developer, QA, DevOps), takes ownership of unassigned issues, reviews pull requests, and writes results back with reviewable markers. Everything stays on your machine: the private instance keeps its own state directory and ports and never touches an existing OpenClaw installation.

zh-CN.title: TeamClaw 桌面版
zh-CN.shortDescription: 把 OpenClaw 实例变成一支协同的虚拟软件团队。
zh-CN.description: TeamClaw 桌面版内置完全离线的 OpenClaw + TeamClaw 运行时，提供原生桌面驾驶舱来运行一支自主软件团队。一次设置向导接好你的 LLM 供应商，之后 TeamClaw 会按自己的节奏巡检你的 GitHub 仓库：规划和分配工作给角色化 worker（PM、架构、开发、QA、DevOps），认领无人处理的 issue，审查 Pull Request，并以可审查的标记回写结果。所有数据都留在你的机器上：私有实例拥有独立的状态目录和端口，绝不影响已有的 OpenClaw 安装。
